config system dns-database
    edit "netops-dhcp-dns.test"
        set domain "netops-dhcp-dns.test"
        config dns-entry
            edit 1
                set hostname "dhcp-dns-a"
                set ip 198.51.100.77
            next
            edit 2
                set type PTR
                set ttl 300
                set hostname "dhcp-dns-a.netops-dhcp-dns.test"
                set ip 198.51.100.77
            next
        end
    next
end
